NFL Hall of Fame Coach Mike Ditka Dies at 86

Mike Ditka, a legendary NFL Hall of Fame coach and former player for the Chicago Bears, has died at the age of 86. Ditka was known for his fiery coaching style and led the Bears to their only Super Bowl title. He was considered a symbol of Chicago.
